query: Lecture Notes Your quill wants to take your lecture notes for you. It writes everything down, word for word, faster than the lecturer can talk. It also writes what it thinks of the lecturer, in the margins. Let it take the notes You have perfect notes, every word, and a margin full of the quill's views on the lecturer's waistcoat. You spend the evening inking them out before anyone sees. Make it take only what you say It sulks, and then takes down exactly what you tell it, no more. It's work keeping it honest. You come out with half the notes and the full trust of your quill.
